Name: Don't Date Relatives
Author: AirynS
Description:
A tiny mod that changes sibling pairs so that they become non-datable and no longer say “(single)” in the social menu if you’re dating, married to, or have divorced their sibling. This will also allow you to reach 10 hearts with the other sibling without needing to date them. It includes an option to disable 10 heart events for undatable characters, which will automatically be set to false if Platonic Partners and Friendships is installed.

[b]Note[/b]: the menu will not update until the next day. I don’t recommend gifting bouquets to both siblings on the same day as it might break your save if you’re dating someone who becomes undatable. I haven’t tested what would happen.

It also has compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking For Love[/url] so that Shane will become unavailable if dating Marnie and vice-versa. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8146]Platonic Partners and Friendships[/url] is highly recommended as a companion mod to remove romantic dialogue and alter the 10 heart event to be platonic. To install, simply extract the “[CP] Don’t Date Relatives” folder and drop it in your Mods folder.

Compatible with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14541]Family Approval [/url]- Don't Date Relatives will take priority﻿﻿.
